nodes.name: useWindow.ts

nodes.name: .gitkeep

nodes.name: testimonial.webp
nodes.summary: Binary WebP image asset used as a testimonial photo in the portfolio UI.

nodes.name: Bookmark.ts
nodes.summary: Mongoose model and schema for user bookmarks, including URL, description, category, tags, and a text index for search.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the mongoose.models.Bookmark || mongoose.model(...) guard to avoid model recompilation in Next.js hot-reload.

nodes.name: PdfTemplate.ts
nodes.summary: Mongoose model for reusable PDF autofill templates, storing the base64 PDF plus an array of positioned template fields for e-signing and form fill.

nodes.name: _app.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js custom App component that wraps every page in the next-auth SessionProvider and logs page visits to the /api/sys-pulse analytics endpoint on route changes.

nodes.name: _document.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js custom Document that sets the HTML lang, preconnects and loads the Outfit Google font, and applies a black body background.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Placeholder file to keep the src/pages/api directory tracked in git.

nodes.name: contact.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route that validates a contact form submission and emails it via a nodemailer Outlook SMTP transport.

nodes.name: generate.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route that sends a text or image prompt to the Google Gemini model and returns structured hierarchical table JSON (columns and nested rows) for the table application.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports a Next.js route `config` object raising the body parser sizeLimit to 10mb for base64 image payloads.

nodes.name: login.tsx
nodes.summary: Login page providing credentials sign-in and Google OAuth via next-auth, with mode toggling, error handling, and redirect to the dashboard when authenticated.

nodes.name: types.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient module declarations letting TypeScript import image and video assets (jpg, webp, svg, png, webm, mp4) as string URLs.

nodes.name: next-auth.d.ts
nodes.summary: Module augmentation extending next-auth Session and JWT types with custom fields such as access tokens, trust flags, and per-feature enablement toggles.

nodes.name: quill-better-table.d.ts
nodes.summary: One-line ambient declaration stubbing the untyped quill-better-table module so it can be imported without type errors.

nodes.name: stylelint.config.js
nodes.summary: Stylelint configuration extending the recommended and order configs, enabling the Prettier plugin, and whitelisting Tailwind at-rules.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.js
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the design system: font, color, spacing, radius, shadow, blur, and animation tokens plus glassmorphism utilities, with the forms and typography plugins.
nodes.languageNotes: class-based dark mode; extensive theme.extend token set including custom keyframes and glass shadow presets.

nodes.name: useInterval
nodes.summary: Sets up a self-clearing setInterval that always invokes the most recent callback, skipping scheduling when delay is null.

nodes.name: useWindow
nodes.summary: Returns the current window size and keeps it in state by subscribing to the resize event on mount.

nodes.name: Document
nodes.summary: Renders the server-side HTML document shell with font preconnects, notranslate meta, and a black body.

nodes.name: handler
nodes.summary: Validates the POSTed name, email, and message and sends the contact email through a nodemailer SMTP transport, returning JSON status codes.

nodes.name: handler
nodes.summary: Builds a system prompt plus optional inline image, calls the Gemini model, strips markdown fences, and returns parsed hierarchical table JSON or an error.

nodes.name: Login
nodes.summary: Login page component managing credentials and Google sign-in via next-auth, form state, error display, and post-auth redirect.
